units.source_text: 源氏穷极无聊，自作主张，专想等候兵部卿亲王来访，以便偷看情状——

en.t: Genji, utterly bored, took matters into his own hands and was intent on waiting for Prince Hyobukyo to visit so that he could secretly observe the situation.

units.source_text: 此种勾当兵部卿亲王一概不知。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo knew absolutely nothing about this scheme.

units.source_text: 他收到了玉鬘的好意的回信，如获至宝，立刻十分秘密地前来访问。

en.t: When he received Tamakazura's kindly reply, he treasured it as though he had found a precious jewel and immediately came to visit in the utmost secrecy.

units.source_text: 边门的房间里铺设着客人坐的蒲团，蒲团前面隔着一个帷屏，主客相距甚近。

en.t: In the room by the side gate, cushions had been laid out for the guest, and with only a curtain screen before them, host and guest were very close to one another.

units.source_text: 源氏预先用心布置，在室中隐藏香炉，使香气弥漫空中，气味异常馥郁。

en.t: Genji had carefully arranged things beforehand, hiding incense burners in the room so that fragrance filled the air with an unusually rich scent.

units.source_text: 如此操心，并非出于父母爱子之情，却是无聊之人的越分行为。

en.t: Such painstaking concern did not arise from a parent's love for a child, but was rather the excessive behavior of a man with too much idle time.

units.source_text: 但其用心毕竟也很周到。

en.t: Even so, his care was, after all, extremely thorough.

units.source_text: 宰相君出来代小姐应对，然而话也回答不出，只是羞答答地待着。

en.t: Saisho no Kimi came out to respond on the young lady's behalf, but she could not manage a reply and merely sat there shyly.

units.source_text: 源氏拧她一把，说：“不要太畏缩呀！”

en.t: Genji gave her a pinch and said, "Do not be so timid."
That only made her even more flustered.
